title: Standing Permission Learner I/O
description: Input/output contract for function 118. No model call anywhere in dispatch.py's own wiring (deterministic grouping/thresholding over GET /decision-history, like Fn 126's own scorecard and Fn 129's own rule engine). This schema exists in the same input/output-wrapper form every other function package uses so _validate_function_input/_validate_function_output can check dispatch.py's own computed shape against a reviewed contract, self-applied rather than applied to a model's reply. PROPOSES ONLY (prompt.md's own words) -- this PR does not build the further step of materializing a GRANTED permission into services/orchestrator/orchestrator/dispatch.py's route_digest_handler, which already documents that gap as Fn 118's own follow-up in its own comment.
